P1 tie with otherCurrentAssets (both sum). FMP switches between the two fields by year (e.g., NVDA: prepaids FY2017-22, otherCurrentAssets FY2023-26); a lower priority here gets shadowed and drops the data.

Aggregate (GW + intangibles) — must NOT back up the Intangibles line: when goodwill is mapped separately and intangibles are 0 (e.g., WMT), activating this double-counts goodwill. Total/Check keeps it visible without summing.
FMP income taxes payable (current); captured as real field. Included in current liab only when <= pre-tax imbalance (see reconciliation block).
Ties with accountsReceivables (P2): when netReceivables is missing, both activate and sum. Verified AAPL netReceivables = accountsReceivables + otherReceivables all years.

Additive at Priority 1 tie with accountPayables (both sum). FMP sometimes reports otherPayables outside its own CL decomposition (AAPL FY2025, NVDA FY2025-26); this row completes the sum. Where taxPayables duplicates otherPayables, the fits test (row 253) auto-drops the tax line — no double count. Note: AP line now = trade + other payables; affects DPO/payables days.

P1 tie with AOCI — FMP catch-all 'other equity' (e.g., AVGO FY2016-18 partnership-era adjustment of −$19-23B). No dedicated Other Equity line; AOCI is the closest bucket. Any double-count surfaces visibly in the balance check.
P1 tie — preferred stock bundled into share capital (no dedicated preferred line in the model; typically immaterial, e.g., AVGO FY2019-21 $27-29M).
